coverage.foscos_catalog_scope: Official FoSCoS/FSSAI indexed rows loaded category by category; Chapter 2.5 synchronization added the current missing meat-product rows while rule ingestion continues.
coverage.foscos_subcategory_framework: Level-2 FoSCoS/FSSAI food-category framework loaded for categories 01–16; special categories without a separate level-2 browse layer are handled directly at product/category level.
coverage.level3_status: Expanded official FoSCoS standardized-product catalogue. Detailed compliance rule profiles remain a separate ingestion layer.
coverage.profile_architecture_note: Every loaded FoSCoS standardized product now has at least a base profile. Full formulation compliance is enabled only when detailed product-specific clauses have been ingested.

3.title: Substances Added to Food
3.regulatory_note: Chapter 3 Version 4 is the current source. Sorbitol 3.2.16(1) is now structured as an identity/purity standard; permission-to-use remains a separate Appendix A/product-standard decision.
3.next_validation: Normalize remaining Chapter 3.2 identity/purity standards and Chapter 3.3 named-substance conditions.

2.1.title: Dairy Products and Analogues
2.1.remaining_work: Normalize named product-variant tables and complete cross-layer validation for additives, contaminants, microbiology, processing aids and labelling before enabling full formulation compliance for every Chapter 2.1 product.

2.2.title: Fats, Oils and Fat Emulsions
2.2.next_validation: Appendix A additive inheritance, contaminants, microbiology/processing-aid applicability, labels and full machine validation
2.2.regulatory_note: Current Chapter 2.2 Version 4 is loaded for the existing structured standards and 2.2.9 Solvent Extracted Crude Vegetable Oils. The current 2.2.9 Corn (Maize) Oil row is 0.5% moisture/insoluble impurities max and acid value 20 max.

2.3.title: Fruit & Vegetable Products
2.3.next_validation: Remaining Chapter 2.3 product standards and named product tables, plus contaminants, microbiology, processing aids and labels. Fermented Soybean Paste 2.3.57 and Vegetable Protein Products 2.3.59 are now structured and mapped to Table 12 FCS routes.

2.4.title: Cereals and Cereal Products
2.4.next_validation: Remaining Chapter 2.4 standard products and product-specific tables; Appendix A, contaminants, microbiology, processing aids and labels

2.5.title: Meat and Meat Products (including Egg and Egg Products)
2.5.regulatory_note: Meat Sausage clause 2.5.2(2A) is included in Version 4; FSSAI direction dated 28.04.2026 extended its compliance period for six months from 01.05.2026.
2.5.next_validation: Appendix A additive inheritance, contaminants, microbiology, processing aids, labels and full machine validation

2.6.title: Fish and Fish Products
2.6.regulatory_note: Current Chapter 2.6 contains 24 active product standards; clause 2.6.1(6) is omitted. Legacy Sardine Oil text is superseded by the substituted Fish Oil standard. Clause 2.6.2 adds formaldehyde limits by fish group.
2.6.next_validation: Appendix A additive inheritance, contaminants, microbiology, processing aids, formaldehyde applicability, labels and full machine validation

2.7.title: Sweets & Confectionery
2.7.regulatory_note: Eight Chapter 2.7 standards are structured. Sugar-boiled confectionery maps to separate FoSCoS hard- and soft-candy rows. Ice Lollies/Edible Ices maps to FoSCoS Category 03. Mouth-freshener rows in FoSCoS Category 05 are not treated as Chapter 2.7 standards.
2.7.next_validation: Appendix A additive inheritance, contaminants, microbiology, processing aids, current labelling rules and full machine validation

2.8.title: Sweetening Agents Including Honey
2.8.regulatory_note: Twenty distinct Chapter 2.8 product-standard groups are structured. Bees Wax is added through the official FoSCoS Category 99 text-box guidance rather than the standard dropdown list. The 2024 draft HFCS standard is tracked as draft_not_active because it is not present in the current consolidated Chapter 2.8. Honey HMF remains limited to 80 mg/kg; FSSAI advisory dated 07.11.2025 clarifies exceedance is categorised as Substandard.
2.8.next_validation: Appendix A additive inheritance, contaminants, microbiology, processing aids, current labelling declarations and full machine validation

2.9.title: Salt, Spices, Condiments and Related Products
2.9.regulatory_note: Current consolidated Chapter 2.9 runs through 2.9.45 with 2.9.25 omitted. Clause 2.9.30 is split into product-specific rule groups for edible common salt, potassium iodate, double-fortified salt and salt substitutes. Harrisa remains base-profile because no matching operative Chapter 2.9 standard is present.
2.9.next_validation: Complete remaining variant-specific numeric tables, Appendix A additive inheritance, contaminants, Appendix B applicability, processing aids, current labelling declarations and full machine validation

2.10.title: Beverages (Other than Dairy and Fruits & Vegetables Based)
2.10.regulatory_note: Four tea standards, Coffee, Chicory, Coffee-Chicory Mixture, four non-alcoholic beverage rule groups, Mineral Water, Packaged Drinking Water and Purified Vending Water are structured. The existing fully validated Carbonated Caffeinated Beverage engine is retained and linked to the Chapter 2.10 rule file rather than downgraded.
2.10.effective_note: Packaged Drinking Water TDS 75–500 mg/L, calcium 10–75 mg/L and magnesium 5–30 mg/L are current from 1 February 2026.
2.10.next_validation: Complete Appendix A additive inheritance, contaminants, Appendix B applicability, processing aids, current labels, external IS references and full machine validation

2.11.title: Other Food Product and Ingredients
2.11.source_version: Current consolidated chapter; no version/date printed in chapter PDF
2.11.regulatory_note: Seven product identities are mapped. 2.11.9 Special dietary food with low sodium content is stored as an overlay because FoSCoS guidance explicitly says it is not listed as a standalone product and must be applied in addition to the underlying food category.
2.11.next_validation: Current additives, contaminants, microbiology, processing aids, Advertising and Claims / current labelling rules, and full machine validation

2.12.title: Proprietary Food
2.12.regulatory_note: Chapter 2.12 is implemented as a deterministic routing/compliance framework rather than product mappings. PMSV now checks the loaded standardized-product catalogue first, then excluded classes, then routes eligible non-standardized foods to the proprietary-food screening flow. Category 15/16 are not hard-coded as proprietary because current standardized mappings may exist.
2.12.proposal_watch: Proposed clauses 2.12.1(1a)/(1b) are tracked but not active because they are not present in the current consolidated Chapter 2.12.
2.12.next_validation: Connect the active router to a full local ingredient-eligibility index permitted by the PMSV source policy, complete Appendix A by selected FCS, Appendix B, contaminants, processing aids, current Labelling and Display, and Advertising and Claims databases.

2.13.title: Radiation Processing of Food
2.13.regulatory_note: Chapter 2.13 is implemented as a process overlay rather than standalone product mappings. The underlying food identity remains primary; radiation class, purpose, dose window, facility/certificate controls and radiation-specific labelling apply additionally.
2.13.foscos_note: FoSCoS guidance states Radiation Processed Foods are not listed as standalone products; select the corresponding Food Category and comply additionally with the process standard.
2.13.next_validation: Connect the radiation-process selector to underlying product profiles and current label rendering before enabling a final radiation-processing compliance verdict.

2.14.title: Gluten Free Food
2.14.regulatory_note: FoSCoS guidance says Gluten Free Foods are not standalone product listings; select the corresponding underlying food category and apply Chapter 2.14 additionally. Gluten-free labelling requires analysed gluten below 20 mg/kg.
2.14.next_validation: Connect the overlay to each underlying product profile, analytical-result input and current Labelling and Display / Advertising and Claims rules.

2.15.title: Food specially processed to reduce gluten content to a level 20–100 mg/kg
2.15.regulatory_note: Chapter 2.15 was omitted by Amendment no. 73 with effect from 1 January 2022. PMSV blocks this former 20–100 mg/kg route from current compliance logic.
2.15.next_validation: None as an active product route; retain only for regulatory-history safeguards.

2.16.title: Hemp seeds and seed products
2.16.regulatory_note: Hemp seed, hemp seed oil and hemp seed flour are structured from the current FSSAI Chapter 2.16. Cross-cutting THC/CBD and labelling restrictions are also loaded. No FoSCoS category is guessed; official current mapping remains pending verification.
2.16.next_validation: Verify current FoSCoS hierarchy mapping, then connect Appendix A, contaminants, microbiology, processing aids and current labelling rules.

appendix_a.next_validation: Continue the remaining 182 base profiles. Next priority: current official Alcoholic Beverages Version V product standards and Foods for Infant Nutrition product standards; blank-FSSR products remain fail-closed unless an exact official mapping is established.

4.1.2.11 — SORBATES 3,000 mg/kg vs 1,000 mg/kg (note 42), no applicability distinction in source

product_mapping_audit.rule: Only codes present in current Appendix A Version 3 permission sets (plus the explicit 1.3.2.2→1.3.2.1 official-source alias and category 16 carry-over route) may feed Appendix A inheritance. FoSCoS licensing categories 18, 99, 100 and products without an official Appendix mapping are fail-closed.

special_nutrition.other_special_route: FSSAI Health Supplements / Nutraceuticals / FSDU / FSMP framework
special_nutrition.next_validation: Load exact composition/additive/label rules for each category-13 subroute before full formulation compliance is enabled.

source_governance.helper_url_audit: All URLs stored in the FSSAI Product Helper were checked; no Instagram, Scribd, news, Wikipedia or other third-party domains are stored as helper evidence.

chapter_rule_link_audit.rule: A chapter profile is not treated as fully specific merely because its parent rule key exists. Composite refined-oil routes link the generic refined-oil rule plus the source-oil rule; explicit variants are tagged; pulses and millets remain variant-detail pending until their grain-specific tables are structured.

base_profile_promotion_audit.rule: Only exact current official mappings were promoted. No fuzzy product-name matching was used. Category 13 exact-name matches remain special-regulation routes, not ordinary chapter profiles.

Food Safety and Standards (Foods for Infant Nutrition) Regulations — current FSSAI compendium/product standards
